text.en:
Tandang Sora Elementary School in Barangay Talipapa in Quezon City is hereby changed to
Placido del Mundo Memorial School in honor of Mr. Placido del Mundo, the philanthropist and civic-minded
person of the said barangay.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: April 27, 1984
